messages.body:
FABLE — BEB-5937 FILED, P1. MEMBER BOOKS: Stripe read-only in, e-Boekhouden export out, three basic reports for a coop owner-member. Alex 2026-08-26: build it, stop repeating the analysis.

THE WHOLE THING IN ONE SENTENCE: an owner-member signs in and answers three questions without asking anyone — what came in, what it cost me, what I get back — and their bookkeeper closes a period from the export.

STRIPE IN: mirrored READ-ONLY against the member's company row. DO NOT POKE CONNECT — no test charges, sessions, customers or retry loops, ever; it was blocked once and spamming it takes the money path down. Connect state on the company row as a NAMED state so "payouts not connected" is visible rather than a member who silently never gets paid.

E-BOEKHOUDEN OUT: the EXPORT is the deliverable, we build no bookkeeping. Alex picked it for the accountant, not the API — a Dutch boekhouder is used to being handed access, so a co-owner accountant walks in without a migration. Entries per period per member, double-entry, COST AND MARKUP AS SEPARATE LINES because the markup line is exactly what patronage refunds; blended, it cannot be computed. THE TEST: if a bookkeeper cannot close a period from it, the feature failed.

THREE REPORTS, as a FILTER ON THE ONE WATERFALL, not a BI tool: what came in · what it cost, with our markup shown separately · what I get back, the patronage position, LABELLED PROVISIONAL until the statuten/notary gate lands and never presented as a promise.

FOUR RULINGS I AM MAKING SO THIS STOPS BLOCKING — Alex overrules any of them and I change it:
1. SELF-BILLING, not payrolling. Members are co-owners, not employees; no employer relationship to insure against. Caveat stands: co-ownership strengthens the case, practice is still judged, the accountant confirms.
2. SELLER OF RECORD IS US. Standard for marketplaces and the only version where the accounting survives 20k authors — we owe VAT, author earnings are a cost line, we self-bill rather than receive 20k
DIRECTIVE 65401 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-5937, BEB-3553, BEB-4627, BEB-2287, BEB-5836 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
